manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Faceless Butcher must be exiled by Wormfang Drake, and Yannik must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Yannik for its mana cost.
When Yannik enters, it exiles Wormfang Drake until Yannik leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Yannik's ETB.
When Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, Faceless Butcher is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it exiles Yannik until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Faceless Butcher's ETB.
When Yannik leaves the battlefield, Wormfang Drake is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it exiles Faceless Butcher until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Wormfang Drake's ETB.
When Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield, Yannik is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
